utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, I’m spreading the word fast about the repair drive so nobody misses it—want me to send you the details or add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Send me the details first, please—especially the date and what repairs they’re accepting. I don’t want us spreading anything until we’ve confirmed it from the actual notice.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll check the actual notice for the date and what repairs they’re accepting, then send you the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Vik, I’m still gathering the latest while I’m out—Quinn seems to be helping with outreach, but I haven’t confirmed who’s keeping the repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira—last I heard, Cleo is keeping the supply list, and Quinn may be helping with outreach. I’m telling folks to bring tools, tape, spare parts, snacks, or anything useful for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—that helps. I’ll pass along that Cleo has the supply list and Quinn’s on outreach, and I’ll tell folks about tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, first let’s get the sign-up sheet open, then we’ll sort repairs by type and mark who’s already covering each one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds right, Eli. I’ll help sort the list quietly as we go, especially noting safety and daily-need repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Rey—let’s put safety items first, then anything folks need for daily use, and we won’t assign names until the sheet confirms who signed up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, before we make any asks, do you have the latest confirmed list of repair categories and who’s already covering each one?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Hana—I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the busiest slots, and Bo has only committed to the 3 to 5 after-school drop-off window so far.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — let’s hold off on asking anyone else until Mara confirms the busy slots and we know whether Bo’s window is the only one covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Bo, I’m still piecing together the repair drive—so far I’ve heard folks need tools, spare parts, and help with bike brakes, small appliances, and screen doors. Have you heard who’s coordinating volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only caught bits from Sam and Faye—Sam mentioned spreading the word and tools, and Faye asked me about the 3 to 5 drop-off window, but I don’t actually know who’s coordinating volunteers yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve been hearing—thanks, Bo. I’ll keep asking around about who’s actually coordinating volunteers and let you know if I get a clear name.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, I’m trying to help tie the pieces together so the repair drive doesn’t stay scattered—right now we’re focusing on small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — that lines up with what I’d heard on appliances and bikes, though I hadn’t caught the clothing piece yet. I can help pass that along, but I’ll keep it marked as the current list in case it changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane—that’s perfect. I’ll check in with Sam’s tool crew, Priya’s sewing circle, and Marco’s cyclists so we can confirm who’s covering each lane before we spread it too widely.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Pia, I think the plan’s Saturday morning collection, sort repairs, and parts list by noon—unless I’ve missed a newer version, which is entirely possible.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah—that matches what I’ve heard for Saturday morning, but I still want to confirm the drop-off spot and who’s bringing tools before we tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, good catch—Gus said he can bring drills, clamps, and a workbench, but I’m fuzzy on the drop-off spot, so I’ll check with Leo before we announce it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo—I'm sorting the repair drive map now, so if you know where your crew plans to set up, I’ll mark their station and nearby supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Put us by the community room tables, near outlets if possible. We’ll need the small appliance bin and basic tool kit close by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Leo—I’ll mark your crew at the community room tables by the outlets, with the small appliance bin and basic tool kit staged close nearby.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Sam. I don’t know all the details yet, but I’m going to ask around quietly and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli—that’s a big help. If you hear who needs repairs or who has tools to lend, just pass it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that, Sam. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear about any repairs or tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mina, I’m trying to pin down the repair drive details before I tell folks—do you know the confirmed time, drop-off spot, or who’s handling the tools?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not confirmed yet, Tess—that’s exactly what I’m trying to lock down. Can you check who has the tool list while I pin down the time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll check who has the tool list and won’t spread anything until you’ve got the time and drop-off spot confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Cleo, the repair drive’s collecting tools this afternoon, and they could still use folks for small appliances, bikes, sorting parts, or coffee duty if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren—I’ll add small appliances, bikes, sorting parts, and coffee duty to the list, plus tools for this afternoon. I’ll check who’s already pledged before I mark anything as covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Cleo—thank you. I’m bringing spare screwdrivers and a little socket set over this afternoon, assuming I don’t set them down somewhere silly first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Mara, I’m bringing drills, clamps, the spare workbench, plus screwdrivers and pliers for the repair drive—anything else you think we’ll need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s a terrific kit, Gus—could you also bring a couple extension cords and label your tools if you can? I’m checking with Opal on station setup so we can place your workbench where it helps most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mara—I’ll bring a couple extension cords and label everything so it’s easy to keep track of. Just let me know where Opal wants the workbench and I’ll set it there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only caught a little about it, Leo, but Quinn seems to be passing details around. I can ask quietly and let you know if they still need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli. Please check with Quinn, and if they need people, send them to Friday evening drop-off or Saturday morning sorting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Leo, I’ll check with Quinn and pass that along quietly—Friday evening drop-off or Saturday morning sorting if they need hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check with Mara and the block chat before I put batteries and tarps on the list, then I’ll share the confirmed needs so Vik and Rosa can spread the right word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo—please send me exactly what Mara or the block chat confirms before anyone posts it wider. I’d rather wait a few minutes than have Vik and Rosa spread the wrong list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I won’t have anyone post until I’ve got confirmation from Mara or the block chat, and I’ll send you the exact wording first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m helping with the repair drive this Saturday morning and keeping track of where tables and supplies end up—do you need a hand with anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam, that would be a big help—could you make a simple map of the table setup and keep a checklist of where the supplies land? I’m trying to keep repairs, donations, and safety needs easy for everyone to find Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll make a simple setup map and keep a checklist as the tables and supplies get placed so everything’s easy to find Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, before we assign anybody, I want to pull up the sign-up sheet and sort it by repair type so we can see exactly what’s covered and what still needs a volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right, Eli—let’s use the sheet before we ask anyone. Can you check small appliances, clothing, and bikes separately so we can spot any gaps?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s a sensible order, Hana: small appliances, clothing, then bikes. I’ll check each category against the volunteer names and note any gaps before we ask anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—what still needs sorting first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Mara—first I want to pin down where each repair station will be set up, then match the tools and volunteers to those spots.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That makes sense, Opal—I’ll check with folks on my block today about what tools they can bring and what needs fixing, then I can pass that list to you for the station layout.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren, I’m pretty slammed, but I’m trying to help with the repair drive—do you know the confirmed date or what kinds of fixes they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh gosh, Bo, I know the tool collection is this afternoon, but I’m not sure I’ve got the main date straight. Last I heard they wanted small-appliance and bicycle fixes, plus folks to sort parts and keep coffee going.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—tool collection this afternoon, and I’ll only mention the appliance/bike fixes as “last I heard” until I see the confirmed notice.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, I’m just catching up on the repair drive, but I’ve heard it’s mostly small appliances, loose bike brakes, and screen door patches—do you have the latest signup list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, Dane—I asked Quinn to put me on the invite list, so I’m waiting on the latest. I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know who’s keeping the signup list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira—that helps. I’ll hold off on making any plans until we know who has the list, and I’ll pass along anything solid I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, do you have the sign-up sheet or the current repair list? I need to know what’s missing before we start sending people around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the sign-up sheet myself—Cleo’s keeping the list, but I know we’re asking for tools, tape, spare parts, snacks, and anything useful this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then I’m going to Cleo for the actual list; can you tell me which repair types those supplies are for, or are we still guessing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Jules—I’m still keeping this narrow: small appliances and bikes only, dropped off by Friday evening. I don’t want anyone bringing bulky items until we’ve confirmed space and tool coverage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense, Pia—small appliances and bikes only, drop-off by Friday evening, and no bulky items yet. I’ll pass that along to the block group and check tool coverage before widening the ask.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules—please make sure folks know Friday evening is the cutoff, not just a suggestion. And let me know what you hear about tool coverage before anyone adds more categories.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Tess, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details, but I’ve heard they need tools, spare parts, and handy volunteers for small fixes—have you heard anything more current?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Only bits so far, Nell — Pia reminded me not to pass anything along until we’ve confirmed the time, drop-off spot, and who’s handling the tools, so I’m checking with the organizers first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense, thanks Tess—I’ll hold off on spreading specifics too, and if you hear the confirmed time or drop-off spot, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Faye. I’ve only heard they need help with small appliances, bikes, parts sorting, and coffee, so I’m trying to learn when everyone’s meeting and what needs fixing most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I’m trying to avoid school drop-off and pickup, so if you hear of a mid-morning or early afternoon meeting time, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Faye — if I hear they’re meeting mid-morning or early afternoon, I’ll let you know. I’m still asking around quietly, so I’ll keep your school schedule in mind.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Gus, thanks again—you’re bringing the drills, clamps, and workbench, right? The drive’s Saturday morning, and I’m trying very hard not to lose track before then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Noah—I’ve got the drills, clamps, and workbench set aside, and I’ll bring the screwdrivers, pliers, wrench set, and extension cord too. I’ll give you one more reminder Friday so it stays on the radar.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks Gus—that’s more than I remembered to ask for. Friday reminder would be a lifesaver, and I’ll try to write down the screwdrivers, pliers, wrench set, and extension cord before this note wanders off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane, I’m glad we could connect about the repair drive—I'm gathering everyone’s input first, and I’d love to hear what repairs you think are most urgent on the block.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I’m still catching up, so I don’t want to overstate it—but I’ve heard loose bike brakes, small appliance fixes, and screen door patches have come up most so far.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s really helpful, Dane—thank you. I’ll mark bike brakes, small appliances, and screen doors as early priorities, then check them against safety needs and what supplies we can gather.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m a bit slammed and only caught a vague mention of the repair drive—do you know the confirmed date and what repairs they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—drop-off is Friday evening, then we sort Saturday morning. We’re accepting small appliances and bikes only, nothing bulky.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Friday evening drop-off, Saturday morning sorting, small appliances and bikes only. I’ll pass that along carefully and see if I’ve got any tools or quick time to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Nell, I’m bringing drills, clamps, a spare workbench, and some hand tools for the repair drive—anything else you think folks might need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really useful, Gus—thank you. I’ve only heard folks may need bike cables, screen patches, and maybe small-appliance parts too, but I’m still piecing it together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know, Nell—I’ll toss in a patch kit and a few general bits, and I can ask around about bike cables and appliance odds and ends before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I’m trying to pin down today’s repair drive details while I’m out—do you know who’s coordinating and who has the list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ira, I’m coordinating as best I can, but Mina has been pushing to pull up the sign-up sheet, so she may have the current list. Let’s not rely on memory—check with Mina first and then we’ll make a clear rundown.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Eli—I’ll check with Mina first about the current list, then circle back so we can get one clear rundown today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Faye, before I pass anything along, can you confirm the repair drive date and what repairs or supplies are actually needed?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the exact date and the highest-need slots, but I’ll ask them for the repair list and supply needs too before you pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Faye—please send me the confirmed date and list once you have it, and I’ll hold off on telling anyone until then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Pia, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list started with tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks, but I’m still confirming what’s needed most. Do you know of anything already pledged or any gaps I should verify?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I wouldn’t count anything as pledged yet, Cleo—we still need the organizers to confirm the tool person and drop-off spot. Maybe mark tools and spare parts as “to verify” for now, and snacks as a separate nice-to-have.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll mark tools and spare parts as “to verify” and keep snacks separate as nice-to-have until the organizers confirm the tool person and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive so nobody misses it—would you like the details, or know anyone with tools or something that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—please share that the repair stations are still being mapped, and ask folks with tools or broken items to note their block and what they’re bringing so I can place them accurately.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Opal—I’ll tell folks the stations are still being mapped and ask them to note their block plus any tools or broken items so you can place everything right.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do you know who has the sign-up sheet right now and whether we’re sorting repairs by type yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think Hana was helping pin down the categories, but I’m not sure who physically has the sign-up sheet right this minute. I’ll check with her and make sure we sort it by appliances, clothing, and bikes so everyone’s not stepping on each other.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—ask Hana who has the sheet and tell me by this afternoon, please. Also check whether appliances, clothing, and bikes are the only categories or if tools need their own slot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, I’m helping gather repair drive details now—do you need help with outreach, station setup, or figuring out a time slot?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mara, that’s perfect — I promised Pia I wouldn’t spread anything until the time, drop-off spot, and tool person were confirmed, so if you can help pin those down, I’ll handle outreach after that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Tess—I’ll check on the confirmed time, drop-off spot, and who’s handling tools before you send anything around, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have all three.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Noah, I’m still piecing it together, but I heard they need help with small appliance and bike repairs, plus sorting parts and coffee. I can probably help with the sorting or coffee side if there’s a meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey—that sounds right, though I may be behind too. Leo said Saturday morning for collection and parts sorted by noon, so if you can handle sorting or coffee then, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday morning works for me; I’ll come help sort parts and can keep coffee going too. If you hear a specific start time, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, before we move anything forward, can you confirm which repair categories are on the current list and who’s already committed to each one?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, let me not overstate it—current list I know is small appliances, bicycles, parts sorting, and coffee; Rey offered sorting or coffee, Vik’s spreading the word, and I’m bringing spare screwdrivers and a socket set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — that helps. I’m noting small appliances, bicycles, parts sorting, and coffee, but I still want to confirm who’s actually covering the appliance and bike repair lanes before we announce anything.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
